newsitem.title: USA: Sixth trainer charged in U.S. Army base sex probe.
newsitem.headline: Sixth trainer charged in U.S. Army base sex probe.

text.p: A sixth trainer at the U.S. Army's Aberdeen Proving Ground has been charged in connection with a sexual misconduct probe, the Army said Friday.

The proving ground said in a statement that an instructor at its Ordnance Centre and School, Sgt. Isiah Chestnut, 26, had been referred to a special court-martial on charges of fraternisation and indecent assault involving four female students at the school.
The new case took to six the number of instructors and trainers at the school charged in connection with a sexual harassment scandal which erupted last November.
One of those charged with sodomy, adultery and other violations has received an early discharge in lieu of a court martial. The others, including two charged with rape, are awaiting courts-martial.
The proving ground said the accusations against Chestnut were reported through an Army hotline set up in response to the scandal.
It said Chestnut, if convicted, faced a maximum penalty of six months confinement, reduction in rank, fines and a bad conduct discharge.
